title: What do you do?
summary: One optional screen after the owner creates a work account, and from the Ramo row of the work account settings (ADR 0194 points 8 to 10): a short list of sectors, Outro and Pular. The sector sets the order of the steps and the first tool the tab suggests. It never limits the tools.

pick.effect: PUT /v1/me/business/sector with the ID, then closes. A failure closes too: the question is optional and the settings row stays.

skip.effect: PUT /v1/me/business/sector with no sector, then closes. Shows the generic path.

notes: Web: the settings row only; a work account is created on the phone (ADR 0226 point 6).
